verdict.rationale: The GitHub docs mention a successful run ending in a 'watch receipt' with a state field (e.g. COMPLETED, exit_code, log_bytes), implying some status-tracking mechanism exists, and 'task start' reports a WORKING state before completion. However there is no dedicated 'watch' command, live dashboard, or streaming log evidence showing real-time observation of an in-progress agent's actions. missing for 10: explicit real-time streaming/monitoring command or UI, documentation of live status polling during execution, independent confirmation of watch behavior.
